description: Source code implementing SSL/TLS support for hiredis, including context creation, connection, read/write operations, and SSL error handling.

classes.name: redisSSLContext
classes.description: Structure representing SSL context including SSL_CTX and server name.

classes.name: redisSSL
classes.description: Structure representing an SSL connection, including SSL object and state flags.

methods.name: redisCreateSSLContext
methods.description: Creates and initializes an SSL context with optional certificates, keys, and server name.

methods.name: redisFreeSSLContext
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an SSL context.

methods.name: redisSSLConnect
methods.description: Initializes SSL connection on a redisContext with a given SSL object.

methods.name: redisInitiateSSL
methods.description: Wrapper to initiate SSL with a provided SSL object.

methods.name: redisInitiateSSLWithContext
methods.description: Wrapper to initiate SSL using a redisSSLContext.

methods.name: redisSSLContextGetError
methods.description: Returns string description of SSL context error codes.
